# Real BiRefNet cutouts

Subject cutouts from the phase 5b generate eval (`out/eval-generate/2026-10-12T01-57-32-671Z_phase5b-hosted-rest`). The images were generated by FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache-2.0) and cut out by BiRefNet on Replicate (`men1scus/birefnet`, MIT). All are clean cuts by eye, and `cutout-quality` flagged every one of them.

| File                       | Case                      | Verdict before the model-cut cap           | Size                |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------- |
| `white-cat.png`            | Same-color subject        | `leftover-backdrop` warning                | 512 px              |
| `white-laptop-screen.png`  | Same-color subject        | `leftover-backdrop` warning                | full size (733×497) |
| `cream-clothing.png`       | Same-color subject        | `leftover-backdrop` warning                | 512 px              |
| `white-dropper.png`        | Same-color + outline step | `bites` error, `leftover-backdrop` warning | 512 px              |
| `dropper-bottle-steps.png` | Outline step              | `bites` error                              | 512 px              |
| `laptop-hinge.png`         | Outline step              | `bites` warning                            | 512 px              |

Most files are scaled to 512 px on the long side. That keeps the verdicts, except for the laptop screen, whose leftover-backdrop signal needs the full size.

The verdicts are measured against a studio backdrop of `[233, 229, 227]`, the border color of a FLUX subject image from the same run.
